text: The cleanliness of the rooms was truly spotless. The bedsheets were pristine and the bathroom was thoroughly cleaned every single morning.
The cleanliness was truly spotless and spotless hygiene throughout. The sheets were pristine and bathroom thoroughly cleaned.
The front desk staff welcomed us warmly and check-in was finished in under two minutes. Fantastic service at the reception!
Reception staff was extremely helpful and courteous when answering our questions about the neighborhood.
Terrible room service experience. We ordered dinner at 8 PM and it arrived cold two hours later. The attendant was very rude on the phone.
Room service was awfully slow and unhelpful. When we asked for extra towels, nobody responded for five hours.
The location is unbeatable! Just a two minute walk to the subway station and surrounded by excellent restaurants.
Great central location downtown, easy access to all tourist spots and metro lines.
The room was quite cramped and the air condition was noisy throughout the night, making it difficult to sleep.
Wonderful swimming pool and modern gym on the rooftop. High speed wifi worked flawlessly for remote work.
Very clean rooms, tidy housekeeping, and pleasant scent in the lobby.
The price is a bit expensive for what you get, but the cleanliness makes it worth it.
